content.user_title: Analyze Off-Site SEO and AI Referral Signals
content.value_statement: Off-site SEO data is hard to trust when backlink exports, toxic-link reviews, and AI referral analytics live in separate tools. This skill structures the analysis, labels evidence quality, and produces reports for backlink cleanup, link building, and AI traffic monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Separates backlink analysis from AI referral analysis with an explicit mode selector.
Reviews referring domains, anchor mix, link velocity, quality signals, and toxic-link share.
Compares competitor backlink profiles to identify link gaps and outreach opportunities.
Defines AI-assistant traffic sources for GA4, Search Console, or server log exports.
Compares AI referral sessions and conversions against organic traffic for the same window.
Creates handoff summaries for monitoring memory and related SEO skills.
limitations: It cannot measure backlink volume without a pasted export or connected link database.
It cannot measure AI sessions without analytics, Search Console, or server log data.
It does not calculate a formal CITE score or replace the domain authority auditor.
It treats AI referral traffic as a lead signal, not proof of prominent AI citation.

use_cases.title: Audit a backlink profile
use_cases.description: Review referring domains, toxic-link share, anchor distribution, and recommended cleanup actions for a target domain.

use_cases.title: Find competitor link opportunities
use_cases.description: Compare competitor referring domains and identify prospects, resource pages, broken links, and outreach angles.

use_cases.title: Monitor AI referral performance
use_cases.description: Use analytics exports to identify ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and other AI assistant traffic trends.

prompt_templates.title: Start a backlink audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a target domain and backlink export.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the backlink profile for my domain using this export. Report referring domains, anchor mix, toxic-link share, and three priority actions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competitors
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for link gap analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my backlink profile against these three competitors. Find shared referring domains, missing opportunities, and the highest-impact outreach angles.

prompt_templates.title: Track AI referrals
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze AI referral traffic for the last 90 days from this GA4 source and medium export. Compare AI sessions and conversions with organic search.

prompt_templates.title: Build a monitoring handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for ongoing SEO and AI traffic monitoring.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run offsite-signal-analyzer in ai-referrals mode. Define the final AI source list, read movement against a control, and create a handoff summary for future monitoring.

output_examples.input: Analyze backlinks for example.com with a referring-domain export.
output_examples.output: A backlink report with profile overview, authority distribution, anchor mix, toxic-link ratio, disavow candidates, competitor gaps, and prioritized next actions.

output_examples.input: Track AI referral traffic from a GA4 export for the last quarter.
output_examples.output: An AI referral summary showing source definitions, sessions, landing pages, conversion comparison against organic search, and movement labels.

output_examples.input: Find link-building opportunities from competitor domains.
output_examples.output: A prospect list grouped by overlap, authority, relevance, outreach angle, effort, impact, and recommended priority.

best_practices: Provide exports or connected tools so counts are measured instead of estimated.
Keep backlink metrics and AI referral metrics under separate headings.
Label every figure as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Do not estimate backlink counts from a domain name alone.
Do not treat AI referral traffic as proof of a high-quality AI citation.
Do not disavow weak links without manual review and removal attempts.

faq.question: What data should I provide for backlink mode?
faq.answer: Provide a backlink or referring-domain export, competitor domains, anchor data, and any prior link-change baseline.

faq.question: What data should I provide for AI referrals mode?
faq.answer: Provide a GA4 source and medium export, Search Console data, server logs, or another analytics export for the same date range.

faq.question: Can this skill recommend disavow actions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify disavow candidates, but it recommends manual review and removal attempts before any upload.

faq.question: Does it replace a full domain authority audit?
faq.answer: No. It prepares off-site signal evidence and can hand authority concerns to the domain authority auditor.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it analyze ChatGPT and Perplexity traffic?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes starter source matching for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, and other AI assistants.
